title: Recognition Cluster Snapshot
description: Tenant cluster snapshot payload returned by the recognition service and projected by the WordPress plugin.

snapshot_version.description: Monotonic version number for the tenant's snapshot state.

source_job_id.description: Job identifier used when acknowledging projection back to the backend.

snapshot_generation_id.description: Snapshot build UUID echoed back during acknowledgement for disposal provenance.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the snapshot was generated.

clusters.description: List of clusters for the tenant.

curation_state.description: Current curation state of the cluster.

is_user_confirmed.description: Whether a user has explicitly confirmed this cluster's identity.

identity_count.description: Number of identities currently assigned to this cluster.

representative_thumb_path.description: ACX-formatted path to the representative thumbnail.

suggested_label.description: Backend-inferred label for unlabeled, unconfirmed clusters. Null when no inference was attempted or the cluster is user-confirmed.

suggested_label_source.description: Source of the label inference. Null when suggested_label is null.

suggested_label_confidence.description: Confidence score for the inferred label in [0.0, 1.0]. Null when suggested_label is null.

suggested_target_cluster_id.description: Target cluster ID for a pending merge suggestion. Null when the source is not similar_cluster.

members.description: List of identities (members) and their cluster assignments.

cluster_uuid.description: ID of the cluster this identity belongs to.

attachment_id.description: WordPress attachment ID for the source media.

bbox.description: Bounding box of the face in pixel coordinates.

thumb_path.description: ACX-formatted path to the identity thumbnail.

similarity.description: Confidence score of the cluster assignment.
